text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky was training smoothly in 
preparation for the Asahi Hai FS.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now, I wonder what our next training will 
be?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Our goal is a GⅠ race after all, so a 
little harder training is problem-free, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Maruzen-san, hello!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was watching your training! I really do 
admire the way you run, Maruzen-san!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Pardon the intrusion~ If I may be so 
bold, I took a look as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Approaching me with gleaming eyes were 
junior racers who have been deemed 
promising since before their debut."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having only recently transferred, Special 
Week was a promising newcomer talked about 
for both her friendliness and her sheer 
ability.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder may look quiet at first 
glance, but people are already saying her 
powerful running is champion-tier.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Her powerful stride and exceptional 
acceleration are certainly breathtaking, 
but above all else..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She looked like she was having a lot of 
fun today as well!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, having everyone count on me is what 
makes running so much fun today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And so, the truth is, I actually have a 
favor to ask of you, Maruzen-san...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You want to run together... don't you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "Wah!? That's right! You figured it out!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"When you come to me with your eyes 
sparkling like that, it's pretty obvious, 
you know."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan looks quiet and gentle too, but 
her drive to run is overflowing.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh my... Fufu, I am terribly sorry~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, would it be alright if I went 
and trained alongside these girls for a 
bit?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, do you mind if I go do a 
side-by-side run with these girls?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Taking on the two of them one after the 
other should make for quite an intense 
workout.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thanks, I'm heading off then!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, Grass-chan, you two should learn 
a thing or two from your big sis.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, I shall learn from this.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All right, let's do our best and rumba!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You too, Grass-chan! Let's do our 
best-rumba!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Um... As long as I can learn how to run, 
that's enough for me...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
This feels so much like youth, doesn't it! 
Let's run toward that setting sun!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Run towards the sunset with me, 
Grass-chan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The sun is still right above us, though...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Today's training was so much fun too~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I wondered if it was really 
okay for someone without a dream like me 
to be running, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I'm having fun running and 
leading by example for my cute little 
juniors."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All of this is thanks to you becoming my 
Trainer, Trainer-kun♪
choice_data_list: I'm glad to see you're having fun.
I'm just glad to see you having fun.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All of this is thanks to you becoming my 
Trainer, Trainer-chan♪
choice_data_list: I'm glad to see you're having fun.
I'm just glad to see you having fun.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, in return, I'll make sure you have 
lots and lots of fun too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? There seems to be a crowd over 
there. I wonder what's going on?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
So then, you're aiming for the pinnacle of 
Umamusume!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I am prepared to devote myself 
single-mindedly to guiding all Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hooldolf, doing an interview?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky, huh. She called out to me on 
my way back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolfâ Student Council 
President of Tracen Academy, and a 
sensation shaking up the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has been winning all her races so far 
undefeated, drawing attention just like 
Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
As expected of someone so popular~! I 
can't afford to lose either♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
The "Supercar" and the "Emperor"...! To 
think both of these highly anticipated 
stars are here!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
From your perspective, Symboli Rudolf-san, 
what kind of presence is Maruzensky-san to 
you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She is another one who will surely bring 
excitement to the Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"In that sense, I have high expectations 
for her."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just running for fun, but hearing you 
say that makes me really happy."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
There's a very strong possibility the two 
of them will face off against each other!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: A showdown...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It is not entirely out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As long as you both keep striving forward, 
your paths are bound to cross. The day 
will surely come when you run together.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: I can't wait starting from right now!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no. I was just letting my imagination 
run wild for a second.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer-kun. Let's keep training 
just a little bit longer!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer-chan. Let's keep training 
just a little bit longer!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of going for a drive after 
this, but now I feel like running on my 
own two feet♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, we shouldn't get in the way of 
the interview, so let's go!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Felt like running, did you...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading into the Asahi Hai FS, 
Maruzensky's skill and enjoyment only 
continued to grow.
